reserve() throws InsufficientStockError, an error from ../errors/DomainErrors, which is a domain-level way to signal an invariant failure.
release() and commit() only call methods on the Product aggregate. They make no repository, database, HTTP or framework calls.
The file has no persistence, transaction, logging or I/O code. Application use cases call this service, which fits it being a domain service.

The file has no persistence, transport, framework, transaction or orchestration code. It doesn't load or save repositories, and it doesn't use I/O or dependency injection decorators. Coordinating an invariant across several aggregates is a standard domain-service responsibility, so every responsibility here fits the domain layer.
